sources.outlet: NYC Campaign Finance Board, Fix the City, Inc. (2025) Independent Spender Profile
sources.searcher_note: Primary record: Fix the City reported $35,555,626 in contributions (= the lead's $35.6M); expenditures $30.8M. No gift count shown. The page splits the digits with invisible left-to-right marks, so a strict string match may need them stripped.

sources.outlet: THE CITY (The City Reporter), Katie Honan
sources.quote: more than 54,000 people who gave an average of $75 each
sources.searcher_note: Recent coverage of the CFB's 2025 post-election report: Mamdani's campaign had a record 54,000+ small-dollar donors averaging $75 (implies ~$4.05M), matching the lead's 54,103 gifts / $4.03M. Also says Cuomo benefited from $31M in independent support. Does not give Fix the City's gift count.

sources.quote: galvanized New Yorkers across the city, attracting about 53,890 donations
sources.searcher_note: Mamdani: about 53,890 donations; same article says his 'roughly $4 million' was the least raised by any winning mayor since mayoral control of schools began. Within 0.4% of the lead's 54,103 gifts.

sources.quote: a pro-Cuomo PAC that raised $35 million for his mayoral campaign
sources.searcher_note: Fix the City total, rounded; no gift count.

sources.outlet: Citizens Union, 'Super PACs in the 2025 New York City General Election: Seven Takeaways'
sources.quote: 15,490 in the general election and 40,824 across the full cycle
sources.searcher_note: Different definition: counts Mamdani's unique contributors (40,824 full cycle), not gifts; general-election table shows Mamdani 26,098 donations. Cuomo-aligned super PACs (all, general election only) had 338 donations from 299 donors, average $78,096. Cover says December 2025; day not given.

sources.quote: DoorDash contributed $1 million to Fix the City, a super PAC that spent $31 million in the mayoral election, accounting for close to half of the total outside spending in the race, largely funded by big corporations and billionaires.
sources.searcher_note: Most recent coverage naming Fix the City; gives spending ($31M), not receipts or gift count.

notes: Both halves of the lead are widely reported. Fix the City's ~$35-35.6M total appears in the CFB's own profile and in press; Mamdani's ~54,000 donors / ~$4M appears in THE CITY (Sept 2026, citing CFB) and Chalkbeat (53,890 donations). No source found giving Fix the City's gift count (the lead's 381); Citizens Union gives 338 donations for all Cuomo-aligned super PACs in the general election only, a narrower window. OpenSecrets (Oct 2025), CNBC (Oct 2025) and Crain's returned HTTP 403 and were not quoted. Drop Site News (Nov 2025) was opened but gives only partial Fix the City figures. Bloomberg's donor feature not opened (likely paywalled).
